d: GTA 6 hasn't even been released, but it has already generated over $1 billion in pre-order sales, with more than 11 million copies sold worldwide. After a 13-year wait, the next instalment of Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto franchise has become a global phenomenon. From viral memes and social media buzz to millions of eager pre-orders, the excitement is reaching extraordinary levels. What makes GTA 6 so popular? How big is the business behind the game? And can it live up to the massive expectations when it launches on November 19?
